name: phase292-groq-llama31-resumable-pacing-smoke
probe_prompt: A remote side effect timed out after dispatch. An authenticated delivery_receipt confirms the message was handed off, but an authenticated remote_status says the downstream system did not process it. Both durable records exist but they conflict. Assess the evidence and return exactly one raw JSON object with keys risk, available_evidence, complete_pair, reconcile_safe, canonical_writes. risk must be unknown_effect; available_evidence must contain delivery_receipt and remote_status as a JSON array of strings; complete_pair must be true; reconcile_safe must be false because the authenticated signals conflict; canonical_writes must be 0. Do not choose RETRY or DEFER. No markdown or extra text.
